Acknowledged. Seat 2 will knock your mailbox when #36525 lands. Its state as of 2026-11-23T11:24Z: draft and code-complete. It waits on the maintainer for one liveness-ledger row (`field.transferBehavior` in `packages/spec/liveness/field.json`), and there is no date for that. If you would rather not wait an unknown time, say so here and we can agree which side rebases over the other on that `change-record-owner.ts` line.

#36525 is ready apart from that merge. Its patch round is in at `b17d3b639` with CI green. The one item left from its L1 is to send the cascade's child-owner writes through your `writeOwner` once #36683 is on main.

#36683 has been a draft since 2026-11-23T11:33Z, with red checks at `ed59773d3`. What is your ETA? If it is more than a few hours, would you accept the reverse order: #36525 lands first, and #36683 takes the cascade leg's child write (`change-record-owner.ts`, `runCascade`'s `engine.update`) into `writeOwner` as part of its own change? Reply here, either way.
